documents.title: Part B - Technical Description of the Project

sub.label: 1.1 Background and general objectives
prompts: Describe the background and rationale of the project.
How is the project relevant to the scope of the call?
How does the project address the general objectives of the call?
What is the project's contribution to the priorities of the call?

sub.label: 1.2 Needs analysis and specific objectives
prompts: Describe how the objectives of the project are based on a sound needs analysis in line with the specific objectives of the call.
What issue / challenge / gap does the project aim to address?
Define objectives that are clear, measurable, realistic and achievable within the project duration.
For each objective, define appropriate indicators for measuring achievement (including unit of measurement, baseline value and target value).

sub.label: 1.3 Complementarity with other actions and innovation - European added value
prompts: Explain how the project builds on the results of past activities carried out in the field.
Describe its innovative aspects (if any).
Explain how the activities are complementary to other activities carried out by other organisations (if applicable).
Illustrate the trans-national dimension of the project; its impact / interest in the EU area.
Show potential to use the results in other countries and develop cross-border cooperation among Programme countries and Partner countries (if applicable).

sub.label: 2.1 Quality of project design and implementation
prompts: Outline the approach and methodology behind the project.
Explain why they are the most suitable for achieving the project's objectives.

sub.label: 2.1.1 Concept and methodology
prompts: Describe the concept and methodology of the project.

sub.label: 2.1.2 Project management, quality assurance and monitoring and evaluation strategy
prompts: Describe the measures foreseen to ensure that the project implementation is of high quality and completed in time.
Describe the methods to ensure good quality, monitoring, planning and control.
Describe the evaluation methods and indicators (quantitative and qualitative) to monitor and verify the outreach and coverage of the activities and results.

sub.label: 2.1.3 Project teams, staff and experts
prompts: Describe the project teams and how they will work together to implement the project.
List the staff included in the project budget (budget category A) by function / profile.
Describe their tasks shortly.
If you do not have all skills / resources in-house, describe how you intend to get them (contributions of members, partner organisations, subcontracting, etc).

sub.label: 2.1.5 Risk management
prompts: Describe critical risks, uncertainties or difficulties related to the implementation of your project.
Describe your measures / strategy for addressing them.
Indicate for each risk the impact and the likelihood that the risk will materialise (high, medium, low), even after taking into account the mitigating measures.

sub.label: 2.2 Quality of the partnership and the cooperation arrangements
prompts: Describe the participants (Beneficiaries, Affiliated Entities and Associated Partners, others, if any).
Explain how they will work together to implement the project.
Show that each has a valid role and adequate resources to fulfil that role.

sub.label: 2.2.1 Consortium set-up
prompts: Describe the participants and explain how they will work together.
How will they bring together the necessary expertise?
How will they complement each other?

sub.label: 2.2.2 Consortium management and decision-making
prompts: Explain the management structures and decision-making mechanisms within the consortium.
Describe how decisions will be taken.
Describe how regular and effective communication will be ensured.
Describe methods to ensure planning and control.

sub.label: 3.1 Impact and ambition
prompts: Define the expected short, medium and long-term effects of the project.
Who are the target groups?
How will the target groups benefit concretely from the project and what would change for them?

sub.label: 3.2 Communication, dissemination and visibility
prompts: Describe the communication and dissemination activities planned to promote the activities / results and maximise the impact.
Clarify how you will reach the target groups, relevant stakeholders, policymakers and the general public.
Explain the choice of the dissemination channels.
Describe how the visibility of EU funding will be ensured.

sub.label: 3.3 Sustainability and continuation
prompts: Describe the follow-up of the project after the EU funding ends.
How will the project impact be ensured and sustained?
What will need to be done?
Which parts of the project should be continued or maintained?
How will this be achieved?
Which resources will be necessary to continue the project?
How will the results be used?
Are there any possible synergies / complementarities with other (EU funded) activities that can build on the project results?

sections.label: 4. Work plan, work packages, activities, resources and timing

sub.label: 4.1 Work plan
prompts: Provide a brief description of the overall structure of the work plan (list of work packages or graphical presentation such as Pert chart).

sub.label: 4.2 Work packages, activities, resources and timing
prompts: Group your activities into work packages.
For each work package, enter an objective (expected outcome) and list the activities, milestones and deliverables that belong to it.
List the specific objectives to which the work package is linked.
Provide a concise overview of the work (planned tasks).
Show who is participating in each task.
Include milestones and deliverables (outputs / outcomes).

sub.label: 5.1 Ethics
prompts: Describe ethics issues that may arise during the project implementation and the measures you intend to take to solve / avoid them.
Describe how you will ensure gender mainstreaming and children's rights in the project activities.
